SHOW DQ INVALID RECORD parent_survives TABLE lightning.metastore.portorium.portorium.ruling_code

SELECT r.ruling_number, r.ruling_date, r.revoked, c.hts10,
CASE WHEN h.hts10 IS NOT NULL THEN 'living'
WHEN substr(c.hts10, 1, 8) IN (SELECT substr(code, 1, 8) FROM lightning.metastore.portorium.portorium.hts_code) THEN 'split'
ELSE 'removed' END AS status
FROM lightning.metastore.portorium.portorium.ruling r JOIN lightning.metastore.portorium.portorium.ruling_code c ON c.ruling_number = r.ruling_number
LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.portorium.portorium.hts_line h ON h.hts10 = c.hts10
WHERE r.ruling_number IN ('N326117', 'N313554', 'N340388', 'N310003', 'N312832', 'N174463')

WITH t AS (SELECT CAST(row_idx AS INT) AS r, CAST(indent AS INT) AS d FROM portorium_files.hts_line
WHERE code_digits = '8518220000'),
anc0 AS (SELECT CAST(x.indent AS INT) AS lvl, max(CAST(x.row_idx AS INT)) AS r FROM portorium_files.hts_line x CROSS JOIN t
WHERE CAST(x.row_idx AS INT) <= t.r AND CAST(x.indent AS INT) <= t.d GROUP BY CAST(x.indent AS INT)),
anc AS (SELECT a.lvl, a.r FROM anc0 a LEFT JOIN anc0 b ON b.lvl < a.lvl AND b.r > a.r
GROUP BY a.lvl, a.r HAVING count(b.lvl) = 0),
par AS (SELECT a.lvl, a.r AS own, max(p.lvl) AS plvl FROM anc a JOIN anc p ON p.lvl < a.lvl GROUP BY a.lvl, a.r),
bounds AS (SELECT par.lvl, par.own, p.r AS pr, min(CAST(x.row_idx AS INT)) AS nb FROM par JOIN anc p ON p.lvl = par.plvl
LEFT JOIN portorium_files.hts_line x ON CAST(x.row_idx AS INT) > p.r AND CAST(x.indent AS INT) < par.lvl GROUP BY par.lvl, par.own, p.r)
SELECT 'path' AS kind, anc.lvl AS lvl, anc.r AS r, x.htsno, x.description FROM anc JOIN portorium_files.hts_line x ON CAST(x.row_idx AS INT) = anc.r
UNION ALL
SELECT 'alternative' AS kind, b.lvl AS lvl, CAST(x.row_idx AS INT) AS r, x.htsno, x.description FROM bounds b JOIN portorium_files.hts_line x
ON CAST(x.row_idx AS INT) > b.pr AND CAST(x.row_idx AS INT) < coalesce(b.nb, 100000000)
AND CAST(x.indent AS INT) = b.lvl AND CAST(x.row_idx AS INT) <> b.own
